rubrics.criterion: Homepage presents Academo's demo directory structure with recognizable category navigation, featured demo cards, and concise educational descriptions.
At least one flagship interactive science or math demo includes live controls that update the visualization without a page reload.
Demo cards and subject pages preserve the clean Academo visual style, including restrained typography, light backgrounds, thin dividers, and teal accent color.
Search or filtering allows users to narrow demos by subject or keyword and updates the visible results immediately.
Responsive layouts keep navigation, demo cards, and interactive controls usable at desktop and mobile viewport sizes without horizontal overflow.
